Q&A Thread Topic:"Stinky Laundry Smelled After Wash and Bleaching, Any Help Please?"
Answer from User:

Yes absolutely!

So your white shirts and underwear smelled funky even though I thought bleach got the smell away... It seems bleach can leave residue that makes towels/whitetowelling and clothes start off stinging your skin but then give that must stinky scent.

The best method for me personally when dealing stank laundry was this:

* Soak laundry in white distilled or plain hot water. Add in ½ -1 cup hydrogen peroxed or baking Soda. The soaking will break the bonds that keep stank odors and smells from coming loose.

Then:

Wear a good filter type face cover while running the load as peroxide will release
